title: Ada and the Clock
author: Noor Coldharbour
blurb: Petra Iversen, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
